name: web-warm-food-delivery-landing-with-giant-headline-behind-smiling-diner
title: Brown and yellow food site with giant 'FLAVOR THAT MAKES HISTORY!' behind a laughing noodle eater and rounded photo cards
whatItIs: A long cream page with a heavy brown headline whose letters are overlapped by a cutout woman eating noodles, a category row of six tinted tiles with one dark selected, dish cards in dark brown, yellow and grey with food photos and yellow Buy Now pills, dark photo sections with a chef and a smiling child in brown cards, a yellow wavy footer band and a brown footer.
whatItMeans: Warm and hungry; brown and yellow feel like comfort food and the joyful diner sells the flavour.
techniques: Put a cutout person in front of a giant headline.
Use rounded photo cards in warm colours.
Alternate cream, dark photo and yellow bands.
End with a wavy divider into the footer.

vocabulary.definition: Giant text partly hidden by a cutout person.
A row of icons for food types.
A coloured card with a dish photo and price.
A wave-shaped edge above the footer.
